suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
optimized_sql:
WITH filtered_aggregated AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_item_id,
        avg(ss_quantity) AS agg1,
        avg(ss_list_price) AS agg2,
        avg(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
        avg(ss_sales_price) AS agg4
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics
      ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
     AND cd_gender = 'F'
     AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
     AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN date_dim
      ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_year = 2001
    JOIN item
      ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion
      ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
     AND (p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N')
    GROUP BY i_item_id
)
SELECT i_item_id, agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4
FROM filtered_aggregated
ORDER BY i_item_id
LIMIT 100
